early_termination: report cause; account residual evaluation horizon as unavailable/unsuccessful, never STOP-free success
threshold_selection: validation only; freeze ten profiles and select top three before independent simulation test and bag
contact_truth: net contact forces and geometric proximity are diagnostics; obstacle contact unknown unless explicitly instrumented
benchmark_gate: actual 1/2/5/10 environment measurements with causal capture, physics independence and memory checks; internal approval record required
resume: completed chunks skipped; failed and interrupted attempts preserved; cohort tile and RNG identities fixed
